authentication: Contemporaneous public direct GET checks without Cookie or Authorization. Actual logged-in browser parity is not proven.
title: v3 uploader video count changes with sensitiveContents=mask, matching v1 item order in tested account
claim: On the same public uploader, v3 users/{userId}/videos reports 1056 with default options, versus 1082 with sensitiveContents=mask. The 11 masked pages return 1082 unique IDs, matching the 1082 IDs and complete ordering of v1 playlist/user-uploaded.
unconfirmed: The semantics of the 26-item difference are not established: do not classify the difference as hidden/private videos.
The default 1056 result was not independently fetched through all pages for exact set comparison.
Different accounts, membership states, short-video listings and cache conditions are untested.
The user-provided HAR separately confirms the presence of the mask query for a different uploader, not these totals.
This finding does not permit bypassing access control or obtaining non-public content.
integration_status: isolated research branch; requires maintainer review before merging/publishing
